order_note: No predecessor: SQL 148 redefines one existing unique index in place and creates one new SECURITY DEFINER function, aws_link_second_mortgagee(uuid, uuid), on the Mortgage Desk schema the AWS databases already have (mortgage_handling_requests with id, tenant_id, check_intake_item_id, status, endorsement_order, total_mortgagees and predecessor_request_id), SQL 90's aws_can_write_tenant(uuid) (SQL 90 applied in production), auth.uid() and role checksops; a read-only production inspect confirms them. The index public.mortgage_handling_requests_one_open_per_check must be live as the Supabase definition (migration 20260715110727: (check_intake_item_id) WHERE status IN ('requested', 'in_progress'), label supabase_20260715110727) or as SQL 148's own ((check_intake_item_id, COALESCE(endorsement_order, 1)) for the same statuses); absent or any other definition is refused (replaced_indexes_replaceable), and the inspect's release_sql_inspect.index_definitions names which one is live. No other valid unique index may key the table on check_intake_item_id alone (no_other_per_check_unique_index: the catalog count other_per_check_unique_indexes must be 0). The applying login must own public.mortgage_handling_requests without FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, or be a superuser or BYPASSRLS (definer_can_write_relations): the DEFINER updates rows no tenant policy lets it update, and only the owner may redefine the index. Expected pre-state in both environments: the function absent and the index at the Supabase definition (release sql148 v1, derived: 508588e6cd7d48ca74411aba8e0220842e0490bde69a881d362966f77e54d862). Where the function already exists (a re-run) it must be owned by the applying login (functions_owned_by_login), keep its jsonb result (function_results_match) and hold no EXECUTE grant other than checksops and the owner, which the file keeps, and PUBLIC, anon, authenticated and service_role, which it revokes (function_acl_replaceable). The ACL after the apply is checksops and the owner. The API change that calls it (aws/functions/api/workflow-rpc.mjs, RPC link_second_mortgagee, overlay member workflow-rpc.mjs with sql_before SQL 148) needs the guarded Lambda path after this pin is applied in that environment; until then the 2nd mortgagee's request is still refused while the 1st is open, as today. No API, Lambda or SPA change is part of this pin. Adds no trigger.
